about: RS-13 ITN corpus (R5 §7 RS-13, RT-39). Written for this project. Each sentence is the spoken text a user would dictate; [words|category|digits] marks one number expression: the number words as spoken, its category, and the digits a written form must contain (separators ignored). Synthesised with macOS say; see docs/fork/spikes/RS-13-itn.md.

owner.about: Number expressions in the RS-09 reading script (READING-SCRIPT.md in eval/asr), marked the same way, to score the owner's own RS-09 recordings (results under ~/wb-bench/results/rs09, never committed). Keys are RS-09 clip ids.
